q: We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Total Rewards & Compensation Analyst to support compensation, benefits, and total rewards initiatives, ensuring competitive and consistent reward practices across the organization.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance , or a related field.
2–4 years of relevant experience in compensation, benefits, total rewards, or HR analytics.
Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent Arabic and English communication skills — both written and spoken.
Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
High attention to detail and ability to handle confidential information.
Ability to work under pressure and in a multicultural environment.
Proactive, organized, and able to plan and prioritize effectively.
r: Support compensation and benefits analysis and related HR projects.
Conduct salary benchmarking and market research to assess competitiveness.
Analyze salary structures, job levels, pay ranges, and compensation data.
Support annual compensation reviews, salary adjustments, and incentive processes.
Prepare compensation reports, dashboards, and presentations for management.
Maintain accurate and confidential compensation and employee data.
Support the development and implementation of total rewards policies and practices.
Collaborate with HR and business stakeholders on compensation-related matters.
